lines.zh: 我被抬进来，放下就没动过。
lines.en: They carried me in and set me down.

lines.zh: 我没有脚，只有一副架子。
lines.en: I have no feet, only a frame.

lines.zh: 底座在石板上蹭也没挪。
lines.en: The base scraped stone and still did not move.
Walking is something I forgot long ago.

lines.zh: 有人推我一下，我才偏半寸。
lines.en: A push tilts me half an inch.
Rust fills every joint of mine.

lines.zh: 这间屋子的地我一次没踩过。
lines.en: I have never trodden this floor once.
You are the ones moving, not I.
I only stand and watch.
The dust travels along the floor.
I cannot even turn around.
If I could walk, I would have left long ago.
I stand utterly still, and have for a long time.
The eye under the patch has never blinked.
The hook hangs in midair.
My shadow has not moved all day.
My jaw hangs open, silent.
The lamp in the room flickers.
Dust has settled on me.
The torn curtain drips somewhere.
Someone walked past my face.
I did not turn my head.
Wood creaks at night.

lines.zh: 这副架子比我记得的更沉。
lines.en: This frame is heavier than I remember.

lines.zh: 我在等一个不会来的班。
lines.en: I wait for a shift that will not come.
Rust runs down from my shoulder.
No heartbeat inside this cloth.
Standing is the whole of it.
You have stopped in front of me.
I see it, and I cannot move.

lines.zh: 你的脸离我的钩子很近。
lines.en: Your face is close to my hook.

lines.zh: 再靠近，你会碰到我的鼻尖。
lines.en: Any closer and you will touch my snout.
My eyepatch sits crooked.
You do not mean to set it right.
You are waiting to see if I move.
I will not.
Your hand rises, then falls.
I can tell you are a little afraid.
You've circled three times; I haven't moved.
I did not even track you with my eyes.
You knocked on my wood.
The sound was hollow.
Your breath lands on my face.

lines.zh: 你的手指停在我钩子前面。
lines.en: Your fingers stop short of my hook.
You raise the lamp to my face.
I gave nothing back.
A split runs through the wood.
I sway and nearly topple.
Dust falls from my shoulder.
It is hollow, so it rings.

lines.zh: 这一下砸到了我的架子。
lines.en: That struck my frame.
I lean, and cannot right myself.
The hook swung for a long while.
You will not break me, will you.
I was never sturdy.
It will take long to mend.
You hold it up before me.
I cannot bite, and cannot swallow.
This frame has no stomach.
I cannot smell it.
Leave it; someone will take it away.
Lower it when your arm tires.
My jaw is nailed shut.
Take it away; do not waste it.
Nobody in this room eats that.
I do not even have saliva.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，我晃了晃。
lines.en: You bumped me and I swayed.
The base held.
My hook nearly caught you.
That was not on purpose.
Do not push; I will topple.

lines.zh: 木头磕在一起，声音很闷。
lines.en: Wood knocks wood with a dull sound.
I am only a statue. Do not bump me.

lines.zh: 我身上的灰落到你肩上。
lines.en: My dust fell on your shoulder.
We only need to part.
You are sturdier than I recall.

lines.zh: 这具身体做不了那种事。
lines.en: This body cannot do such a thing.
I am only an ornament, nothing more.
There is nothing inside.

lines.zh: 你对着我说这些，很奇怪。
lines.en: It is strange to say that to me.
My joints are rusted shut.
Do not expect an answer.
Find something living for that.
I cannot even lower my head.
Go on.
I should not be asked this.
I cannot even reach out a hand.
It fell at my feet.
I see it, and cannot pick it up.
The hook is too blunt.
Pick it up; I will not grab it.
It lies inside my shadow.
Whoever dropped it should come get it.
My fingers are fixed in place.
It has lain here a while.
Dust has covered half of it.

lines.zh: 雕像的钩子，还是抬着的。
lines.en: The statue's hook is still raised.

lines.zh: 我记住了，可我做不了什么。
lines.en: I remember, and there is nothing I can do.

lines.zh: 我的架子不会因为生气而动。
lines.en: This frame will not move out of anger.
You are waiting for me to hit back.
You will wait in vain.
My hook hangs where it hangs.
Stand back; do not break me.
Striking me is pointless.

lines.zh: 你会在别处见到会动的我。
lines.en: You will meet a moving me elsewhere.
Settle it then.

lines.zh: 我的钩子动不了，你也知道。
lines.en: My hook will not move, and you know it.

lines.zh: 打在这里的痕迹会留很久。
lines.en: Marks struck here will last a long while.

lines.zh: 要是换成别的那副，你早跑了。
lines.en: Were I the other one, you would have run.

lines.zh: 你的靴子碰到了我的底座。
lines.en: Your boot is touching my base.

lines.zh: 这具架子只会晃，不会扑。
lines.en: This frame only sways; it does not lunge.
You are done hitting, and I am still here.
You sway in front of me.
I cannot follow you.
My eyes are painted on.

lines.zh: 你走到左边，我就看不见了。
lines.en: You step left and I lose you.
And you come back.

lines.zh: 这间屋子只有我能站中间。
lines.en: Only I stand in the middle of this room.
You are standing on my shadow.

lines.zh: 我在这儿什么也做不了。
lines.en: I can do nothing from here.
Wait until the lights go out.
I am thinking the same.

lines.zh: 帘子的影子盖住了我的脸。
lines.en: The curtain shadow covers my face.
The floorboards under you creak.
I cannot count your steps.
Your light sweeps this way.
I see it, and still do not move.
You are on my left; I know.
You are the only thing moving in this room.
I will wait until you turn away.
I cannot raise my hook.
This blow exists only in your head.
My wooden arm will not move a hair.

lines.zh: 你想看我会不会扑上来。
lines.en: You want to see if I lunge.
I have no such mechanism.
Do not come so near my hook.
Even hanging things can wound.
You walked into it yourself.
I cannot even shout a warning.
Stand farther off and nothing happens.

lines.zh: 钩子挂在那里，碰巧在你脖子高度。
lines.en: The hook hangs at your neck height by chance.
If you walk into it, that is not my doing.

lines.zh: 我的木头手臂是钉死的。
lines.en: My wooden arms are nailed in place.

lines.zh: 这一下你要是怕了，就退。
lines.en: If that frightens you, back away.
I have no teeth, only this jaw.
Do not put your hand in my chest.
Someone moved me here.
I used to hang on a wall.

lines.zh: 放我下来的时候磕了一下。
lines.en: They bumped me setting me down.
I show from behind the curtain.

lines.zh: 这间屋子比我记得的亮。
lines.en: This room is brighter than I remember.
A scrap of cloth still hangs on my hook.

lines.zh: 他们把我摆成了这个姿势。
lines.en: They posed me like this.
I do not like it at all.
The lamp shines on me, hard on the eyes.
Plenty come to look at me.

lines.zh: 他们把我摆在这里当招牌。
lines.en: They set me here as a sign.
My back is to the wall; I cannot move.
This lamp bleaches my face.

lines.zh: 你推门进来的时候，我就看见了。
lines.en: I saw you the moment you came through the door.

lines.zh: 这里的地板我一次没走过。
lines.en: I have never walked this floor once.

lines.zh: 布条还搭在我的钩子上。
lines.en: A strip of cloth still rests on my hook.
This room gets loud at night.

lines.zh: 你要是留到那时候就明白了。
lines.en: Stay until then and you will understand.

lines.zh: 火从木头里烧起来，我扑不灭。
lines.en: Fire eats into the wood and I cannot put it out.

lines.zh: 我倒下去，木头散了一地。
lines.en: I topple and the wood scatters.

lines.zh: 水渗进空壳里，我越来越沉。
lines.en: Water seeps into the hollow and I grow heavy.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀翻，帘子也撕了。
lines.en: The blast flips me over and tears the curtain.
An arrow buries in my shoulder board.

lines.zh: 那道光让我整副架子发麻。
lines.en: That light sets the whole frame tingling.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，只是旧得更快。
lines.en: I never eat; I only age faster.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，木头都焦了。
lines.en: Lightning hits me and the wood chars.

lines.zh: 地板没了，我直直落下去。
lines.en: The floor is gone and I drop straight down.
